# pve_file_download_url (Action)

Download a URL into a storage file.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_file_download_url" "example" {
  config {
  content = "iso"
  filename = "CHANGE_ME"
  node = "pve1"
  storage = "local"
  url = "CHANGE_ME"
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_file_download_url.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) Content type. One of: `iso`, `vztmpl`, `import`.
- `filename` (String) The name of the file to create. Caution: This will be normalized!
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `storage` (String) The storage identifier.
- `url` (String) The URL to download the file from.

### Optional

- `checksum` (String) The expected checksum of the file.
- `checksum_algorithm` (String) The algorithm to calculate the checksum of the file. One of: `md5`, `sha1`, `sha224`, `sha256`, `sha384`, `sha512`.
- `compression` (String) Decompress the downloaded file using the specified compression algorithm.
- `verify_certificates` (Boolean) If false, no SSL/TLS certificates will be verified. (default: 1)
